newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HORSE RACING-HK punter takes home US$8 mln horse race payout.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HK punter takes home US$8 mln horse race payout.

text.p: Four lucky punters were counting their winnings on Thursday after one of the biggest payouts in Hong Kong horse racing history.
The Hong Kong Jockey Club said it will pay HK$63.6 million (US$8.23 million) to the holder of a HK$10 (US$1.30) ticket for a Triple Trio wager on races run at Sha Tin on Wednesday night.
Three other punters will take home half that amount for their HK$5 minimum bets.
To win the Triple Trio, the lucky punters picked the right combination from more than 48 million possibilities, choosing the first three horses across the line in any order in three selected races.
Dreams of winning the huge purse had gripped the territory, leading to long queues and extended opening hours at Jockey Club off-track betting outlets.
